subtitle: Lesson 27 · Giving datasets the same guarantee Git gives code

code:
dvc init
dvc add data/train.csv
git add data/train.csv.dvc .gitignore
git commit -m "Track train.csv with DVC"
dvc remote add -d storage s3://ml-datasets/store
dvc push
caption: Git tracks a tiny .dvc pointer; the actual bytes live in object storage, resolved by content hash.

code:
stages:
  prepare:
    cmd: python prepare.py raw.csv train.csv
    deps: [raw.csv, prepare.py]
    outs: [train.csv]
  train:
    cmd: python train.py train.csv model.pkl
    deps: [train.csv, train.py]
    outs: [model.pkl]
caption: dvc repro re-runs only the stages whose declared dependencies actually changed.
